## ⚠️ STOP — please use private disclosure

**Please do not report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues.**

Instead, follow the responsible-disclosure process documented in
[SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md). The maintainers will acknowledge your
report privately and coordinate a fix.

If you opened this issue by mistake, please:

1. **Edit the issue and remove any vulnerability details** (don't leave them
   in the issue's history).
2. **Close the issue.**
3. **Re-report via the channel in SECURITY.md.**

If you are not reporting a vulnerability and just want to discuss security
practices generally, the issue may stay open — please remove this template
text and describe your topic.
